title_sq: Ne Ali Dem, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2+Verand Ne Ndertim Te Ri!!!
description_sq: Ne Ali Dem Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 me Verand Ne Ndertim Te Ri, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati te ri 7 katesh ne ndertim e siper dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 123 m2 nga te cilat 84 m2 bruto dhe 39 m2 jam siperfaqe verande . title_en: In Ali Dem, 2+1+2+Veranda Apartment for sale in New Building!!!
description_en: In Ali Dem, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with a veranda in a new building, with a regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new 7-story building under construction and has a gross area of ​​123 m2, of which 84 m2 is gross and 39 m2 is the veranda area. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets and the veranda that describes the entire perimeter of the apartment. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for the high quality of the works. It is currently in the stage of plastering and will soon become habitable. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
